New homes listed on the MLS® now in Abbotsford

Every listing in the search above is an active MLS® listing in Abbotsford with the board's age field set to 0 or less, meaning completed this year or listed ahead of completion. Houses, townhomes and condos are included, and land and income properties are not. A lot of presale homes are sold by the developer and do not appear on the MLS® until near completion, which means the search is a part of the new-home market, not all of it.
What newer homes in Abbotsford have sold for
The most recently built homes that sold in Abbotsford from November 2025 to October 2026 were duplexes in Abbotsford East. Their median build year was 2026; 7 sold at a median of $999,000.
1 of 17 sub-area and home-type groups with 5 or more sales had a median build year of 2020 or later. The newest were Abbotsford East duplexes (built 2026).

blocks.text: Abbotsford presale projects at a glance

The list holds 8 presale projects in Abbotsford with estimated completion between 2027 and 2028: 6 in 2027, 2 in 2028. By type, that is 5 condo projects, 1 townhome project, 1 mixed condo and townhome project, 1 duplex project.

3 of the 8 have a price published and dated within the last three months. The lowest published starting price is at Sage (Sage 3 currently marketed): from $314,900. For the other 5, the price is either not published or the price I have is too old to show, so ask me for the current list.
A deposit structure is published for 8 of the 8.
Developers with more than one project here: Diverse Properties (2).
The largest project with a confirmed home count is Sage (Sage 3 currently marketed) at 455 homes.
